UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile storing Google account metadata.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this profile document.

googleDisplayName.description: Display name sourced from Google Sign-In profile.

photoUrl.description: Authenticated Google account profile picture URL.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents scoped strictly to the owning authenticated user.
